descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S16 Who gave the order × said 'task' → task or not (both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Orders for others ('PT to walk him') are not tasks unless the physician says 'task', in both contexts. (TFA-92597 R10; TFA-92597 AC 1)
  • U6 'Let's start X' is a plan: it becomes a task, not a row. (UAT TC-19 ER 3; TFA-92597 R3)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident; live models

When Hospital: type the Hospital text in the encounter notes and Save & Extract, open Post-Round → tasks. Nursing Home: type the Nursing Home text and Save & Extract, open the tasks list

Then Cells: physician's own plan, no codeword ('Let's start metolazone', 'Let's start vitamin B12') → task; another discipline, no codeword ('PT to walk him', 'Nursing to check fingersticks', 'PT to work on transfers', 'Nursing to weigh her daily') → no task; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint: tasks mustContain the 'task' cells, mustNotContain the no-task cells. The dietitian result is in spec.manual: main leaves nutrition out of the delegation filter on purpose (convex/lib/delegatedTasks.ts), and whether that is right is Q20. …

Where it ran: dev unit U29; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
